I confirmed `exactOptionalPropertyTypes` is unset (defaults false — it is *not* part of `strict`). Under EOPT=false the `?` marker re-admits `undefined` regardless of the declared type, so the accepted value domain (omitted / explicit `undefined` / concrete valid value) and the read-site type are **identical** before and after. A simpler rewrite would have been a regression; this one is not.
